decisions.reason: As a large bulk container close to the firm's established offer and given a dedicated webpage, it signals high sunk investment and visible public commitment, so escalation of commitment suggests persistence.
It builds on the established offer and has its own webpage, reflecting visible commitment and accumulated investment, making withdrawal less likely under escalation of commitment.

Although it aligns with the announced service-based direction, it has only a website mention rather than a dedicated page, indicating lower visible commitment and thus a higher, but still not dominant, chance of being dropped.
